title: Log Pipeline
prompt: Implement error_rate(lines) — lines are strings like 'ERROR: disk full' or 'INFO: ok'. Yield-free helper allowed. Return the fraction (round to 2 decimals) of lines that start with 'ERROR: ', ignoring blank/whitespace-only lines. Use a generator pipeline internally (no full-list copies of filtered results). Empty/blank-only input returns 0.0.

tests.name: computes the fraction
tests.code:
lines = ['ERROR: a', 'INFO: b', 'ERROR: c', 'INFO: d']
assert error_rate(lines) == 0.5

tests.name: ignores blank lines
tests.hint: Blank lines are not denominator food.
